objective: Freeze and independently review the minimal ward/community boarding boundary contract before implementing new CareOps API semantics.
steps: Freeze the single-ward-bed ED-to-community feedback boundary as a synthetic, single-process contract with exogenous integer-time inputs.

Require separation of ward clinical readiness, destination-place availability, pickup availability, physical departure, arrival, explicit handover acceptance/claim release, emergency admission and horizon censoring.
Obtain independent reviewer-agent feedback on contract completeness, physical timing, boarding semantics, horizon ties, and claims kept out of scope.
Apply any contract fixes, rebind the packet to the final ADR digest and record exact hashes and review outcome.

verification.oracle: Packet binds to the exact base, objective and inputs with no validation errors.
Contract, packet and evidence contain no whitespace errors.

acceptance: ADR-0013 defines the ED-to-ward-to-community single-bed scenario and exogenous input semantics without clinical defaults.

Actual departure is gated on clinical readiness, community-place availability and pickup availability; physical occupancy ends at departure while the origin claim remains held until arrival and handover.
Emergency admission and boarding reflect origin-claim release only after explicit handover completion, preserving the A4.2 ownership contract.
Inclusive horizon, separate arrival/pending-handover/in-transit states, zero duration and checked arithmetic expectations are explicit.
The ADR is reviewed by an independent agent/subagent and no implementation starts before contract findings are closed.
stop_conditions: A4.2 transfer contract does not support the boundary assumptions
Boarding feedback requires unbounded queue/capacity policy or site-specific clinical thresholds
A review finding requires multi-bed allocation or a new external runtime
